title: 4 NPA members, including 2 leaders, surrender in Masbate

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY— Four members of the New People’s Army (NPA), including two ranking leaders, surrendered to government forces in Masbate, yielding firearms, improvised explosive devices (IEDs), and hundreds of rounds of ammunition, the military said Saturday, Nov. 14. Brig. Gen. Angelo Lutera, commander of the 903rd Infantry Brigade, identified the surrenderers by their aliases as Marzan, also known as Marjon, commander of KLG North, SRC 4, BRPC; Larry, also known as Jaime, the group’s vice commander; and two other members identified as Paca, also known as Gabi or Sharon, and Ronel, also known as Aro or Dante.
